strings.name: Megan Rapinoe
strings.summary: Rapinoe’s crosses, set pieces and crucial goals helped the United States win two World Cups and London Olympic gold. In 2019 she won the World Cup Golden Ball, Golden Boot and women’s Ballon d’Or. A longtime Seattle player, she worked with teammates for national-team pay equality and advocated gender and minority rights. Retired in 2023, she was elected in 2026 to the 2027 National Soccer Hall of Fame class.
